top_news.title: Causal neural set filtering for online multi-target tracking
top_news.dek: Causal Neural Set Filtering (CNSF) improves multi-target tracking efficiency by processing only current measurements instead of re-encoding entire windows.
top_news.brief: Transformer-based multi-target trackers often suffer from redundant computation by repeatedly re-encoding measurement sequences. CNSF introduces a neural set filter that maintains state through recursive updates, significantly reducing the computational overhead while maintaining tracking accuracy.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the flow of measurement data through the CNSF architecture

top_news.title: Dropbox Outlines How Focusing on Existing Infrastructure Efficiency Can Create Headroom for AI
top_news.dek: Dropbox details infrastructure optimization strategies to support AI workloads without relying solely on new data center capacity.
top_news.brief: Dropbox is managing increased AI demand by focusing on existing infrastructure efficiency. Their approach includes advanced forecasting, improved fleet utilization, and optimized hardware lifecycles, demonstrating that operational efficiency can create significant headroom for compute-intensive AI tasks.

top_news.title: Stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training
top_news.dek: Cloudflare introduces a setting to block AI training scrapers while maintaining search engine discoverability.
top_news.brief: Website owners can now use Cloudflare's new 'Disallow AI Training' feature to distinguish between search crawlers and AI scrapers. This allows sites to remain indexed in search results while preventing large organizations from using their content for model training, addressing a long-standing trade-off for publishers.
top_news.image_alt: Cloudflare dashboard interface showing bot management settings

top_news.title: Mistral AI: Mistral x Mozilla: Private, Multilingual AI Browsing
top_news.dek: Mistral AI and Mozilla partner to integrate Mistral models into Firefox's new AI browsing assistant.
top_news.brief: The 'Firefox Smart Window' beta now utilizes Mistral models to assist users with complex searches and tab management. The partnership focuses on providing private, multilingual AI capabilities directly within the browser, initially rolling out to users in France and North America.
top_news.image_alt: Firefox browser interface with the Smart Window AI assistant active

top_news.title: Gemini Live audio
top_news.dek: Google's new Gemini 3.8 Live models enable real-time, interruptible speech-to-speech interactions.
top_news.brief: Google has launched Gemini 3.8 Live and an 'Extended Thinking' variant, offering speech-to-speech capabilities similar to GPT-Live. These models support low-latency voice conversations, allowing users to interrupt the AI mid-response for more natural, fluid interaction.
top_news.image_alt: Web interface screenshot showing a real-time voice conversation transcript
